notes.title: Memoranda Update v1.1
notes.content:
A new update (v1.1) is now available for [b]Memoranda[/b]. There have been some improvements to better lead the player along the game, including some new dialog and memos. There's also a lot of small improvements throughout the game to hopefully provide a better experience. As always, please let us know if you find any bugs or issues if you encounter any.

Next up on our list is to add localizations to the game. It will take some time to translate, quality check and do the editing required to incorporate them, so stay tuned for it.

If you have any questions or want to report a bug, you can reach us at memoranda@digitaldragongames.com

Thanks to all of our players and have fun!

notes.title: The PC games of 2017 mega-preview
notes.content:
As Old Father Time grabs his sickle and prepares to take ailing 2016 around the back of the barn for a big sleep, we’re looking to the future. The mewling pup that goes by the name 2017 will come into the world soon and we must prepare ourselves for its arrival. Here at RPS, our preparations come in the form of this enormous preview feature, which contains details on more than a hundred of the exciting games that are coming our way over the next twelve months. 2016 was a good one – in the world of games at least – but, ever the optimists, we’re hoping next year will be even better.

notes.title: Memoranda brings magical realist adventure to January
notes.content: Magical realist adventure game Memoranda [official site] wowed us with its looks when it turned to Kickstarter last year and now that it’s got a release date, yup, I’m still going “Ooh!” Memoranda is the story of a woman who may or may not be losing her memory in a strange world. Its makers cite the strange stories of Japanese author Haruki Murakami as a huge influence. Here, come watch this new trailer: … [visit site to read more]
